turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for holding, you're through to Priya at Retailer One. Before we start, I need to let you know that this call is being recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. Do I have your consent to continue?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that's fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Can I confirm I'm speaking with the account holder, David Nguyen, and that you're authorised to make changes to this account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, David Nguyen speaking. It's my account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks David. And the supply address is unit 8, 44 Barkly Street, Carlton, three zero five three?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's right.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You called in about the Secure 12 plan. Before I take you through the pricing there's a statement I'm required to read you in full.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The Default Market Offer is the reference price set by the Australian Energy Regulator. The estimated annual cost of this plan is seven per cent less than the reference price for an average household in your distribution zone. This is an estimate only, and your actual cost will depend on your usage.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Seven per cent under the reference price. Understood.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Now the numbers. On Secure 12 your peak usage rate is 29.7 cents per kilowatt hour including GST, and the daily supply charge is 104.9 cents per day. Both of those rates are fixed for twelve months from your transfer date.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Twenty-nine point seven, fixed for a year. And there's no exit fee if I move out?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No exit fee at all, even inside the twelve months. The fixed term protects your rate, it doesn't lock you in. If you move house you just tell us and we close it off.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's what I wanted to hear. I'm renting so I might move.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Then this suits you. I'll also send the Basic Plan Information Document by email, and you have a ten business day cooling-off period from the day you receive it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Two required questions. Does anyone at the property rely on life support equipment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And do you hold a pensioner concession card, health care card or DVA card?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I don't.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Just so you have it, if you ever have trouble paying a bill we have a hardship program you can join by calling the number on your bill.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Noted, thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: On billing, you'll be on quarterly to start. You can move to monthly in the app once the account is live. Is the meter accessible from the street?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's in the building's meter room. The body corporate gives them access, the current mob manage fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's fine, the same meter reader services the building regardless of retailer, so nothing changes there.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: So that's the plan, the rates, and the terms. Are you happy for me to set this up for you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you David. I'll take that as your consent to transfer the electricity account at unit 8, 44 Barkly Street to Retailer One on the Secure 12 plan on the terms I've read to you. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that's correct.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Lovely. Now the email for your welcome pack and contract. What's the best address?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's d dot nguyen at outlook dot com. D for David, dot, n-g-u-y-e-n, at outlook dot com.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: d dot nguyen at outlook dot com. I'll read that back to be safe: d, dot, n for November, g, u, y, e, n, at outlook dot com. Correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's it, yes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And the NMI on your bill, I've got 6 1 0 3 0 9 9 8 8 7 7. Can you confirm that against the front page of your last bill?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Six one zero three zero nine nine eight eight seven seven. Yes, that's the one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And this is for electricity only, no gas at this stage?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Electricity only. The building doesn't have gas.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Electricity only, noted. On payment, would you like direct debit or would you rather pay manually each quarter?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Manual is fine, I'll pay it when it comes in.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem, no direct debit set up. Your bill will arrive by email with a BPAY reference on it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's everything from me. Welcome pack and the Basic Plan Information Document within one business day, cooling-off runs ten business days from when you receive it, and the transfer lines up with your next meter read.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thanks for being clear about it all.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: My pleasure David. Anything else I can help with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's everything.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks very much for your time. Have a good morning.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You too. Bye.
